username.title: Username
username.description: Username used when logging into your RControl or DSC Connect account.

password.title: Password
password.description: Password used when logging into your RControl or DSC Connect account.

enableZoneSensors.title: Enable Zone Sensors
enableZoneSensors.description: Register each alarm zone as a HomeKit contact/motion sensor.

imei.title: Panel IMEI
imei.description: If your account has more than one panel registered, the IMEI of the one this accessory should control. Leave blank to use the first panel on the account.

partitionNumber.title: Partition Number
partitionNumber.description: If your panel has more than one partition, the partition this accessory should control. Leave blank to use the first partition on the panel.

pollingIntervalSeconds.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollingIntervalSeconds.description: How often to check for arm/disarm state changes, and for zone state changes when zone sensors are enabled.

assumeUnknownStateIsTriggered.title: Assume Unknown State Is Triggered (experimental)
assumeUnknownStateIsTriggered.description: M2M has no confirmed status code for an actively triggered/sounding alarm. When enabled, any unrecognized status is reported to HomeKit as triggered instead of disarmed - this is an educated guess, not a confirmed API behavior, so it's off by default.
